statement: Transparent data-rate table. raw_payload_bit_rate = channels x sample_rate x bits/sample. For biopotential rows (EEG/EOG) sample_rate_hz is the resampled SCIENTIFIC/MODEL STREAM rate (100 Hz), which is distinct from the AFE hardware acquisition rate (ADS1299-class >=250 SPS, see hardware_acquisition_rate_sps). RAW excludes framing, protocol, and compression. RADIO_DATA_RATE and PROCESSED_DATA_RATE are NOT computed (overhead/compression/schedule open).
equation: raw_payload_bit_rate = channels x sample_rate_hz x bits_per_sample

rate_class_separation.HARDWARE_ACQUISITION_RATE: AFE ODR (e.g. ADS1299-class >=250 SPS); see per-row hardware_acquisition_rate_sps
rate_class_separation.SCIENTIFIC_MODEL_STREAM_RATE: resampled rate fed to the model (e.g. 100 Hz Sleep-EDF); used for payload rows here
rate_class_separation.RAW_SENSOR_DATA_RATE: computed from the stream rate where channels/rate/bits are frozen

modalities.note: 64 Hz is a REFERENCE_SCHEDULE_ASSUMPTION; 19-bit MAX86141 conversion.
report cadence open; placement LOCATION_UNRESOLVED. NOT_READY (not zero).

modalities.hardware_acquisition_note: ADS1299-class minimum ODR is 250 SPS; the 100 Hz value is the resampled Sleep-EDF scientific/model stream, not raw hardware acquisition.
modalities.note: Scientific use case: 1 EEG derivation @100 Hz (model stream). AFE-capacity framing = 4ch x 250 SPS x 24 = 24000 bps.

modalities.hardware_acquisition_note: ADS1299-class minimum ODR is 250 SPS; the 100 Hz value is the resampled scientific/model stream, not raw hardware acquisition. On the shared AFE at 250 SPS the payload would be 6000 bps.
modalities.note: Matches frozen results/eog_operational_burden_day10.json (2400 bps at the 100 Hz model stream rate).

head_module.note: scientific use case enables 2 of 4 channels @100 Hz
